providers: existing host AuthProvider and BrowserRouter only; no new roots/providers
registrationLocation: frontend/src/auth/AuthRouteHost.tsx existing Routes before catch-all; owner must reconcile final target host first
directOpen: GET options without IDs returns permitted active branches; explicit user selection required; never choose first
invalid: duplicate/empty/noncanonical/nonpositive/unsafe IDs fail locally before GET; retain URL and show error
unknownInactiveStaleCrossBranch: room-specific options 400; denied/inactive/unknown branch 403; retain context; POST independently verifies locked current sources
history: location key and search remount form; browser refresh/back/forward reread authoritative options
roomVersion: no room version token exists in this candidate; current-state revalidation only; do not claim historical version/If-Match protection
successfulCreate: display incident number and exact returned context in place; no assumption of INCIDENT_VIEW permission or registered detail route
